verdict.rationale: Abacum's own marketing says it runs AI inside the customer's model and returns answers grounded in business data, and it describes itself as an AI-native FP&A platform. That supports AI answers from in-product data. Nothing in the pack describes proactive insights, anomaly detection or suggestions, and the narrative auto-update is not explicitly AI-driven. Missing for 10: documented proactive AI insights or suggestions, detail on how AI analysis surfaces in the product, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Abacum runs AI inside your model, so every answer is consistent, reusable, and grounded in how your business actually works.
Abacum is an AI-native FP&A (financial planning and analysis) platform for CFOs and finance teams.
